project.name: Minecraft X-Ray Mod
project.description: Multi-author, modular redesign of the Minecraft X-Ray suite spanning canonical AmbientOcclusion foundation, Dromar LaunchWrapper infrastructure, and MisterBartra modern mod-loader intelligence.

ao.name: Suite AO
ao.author: AmbientOcclusion
ao.role: Game Hooks, Mapping Resolution & Core X-Ray Logic
highlights: Pure canonical X-Ray foundation and game logic
Binary mapping resolution via embedded .tsrg.bin tables
Self-contained GUI installer for vanilla launcher profiles
Multi-profile ore visualization and cave finder

dlb.name: Suite DLB
dlb.author: DromarLeBanisseur
highlights: Dual extraction mechanism at installation time
Modular encapsulation isolating launch orchestration from game bytecode

mb.name: Suite MB
mb.author: MisterBartra
mb.role: Mod-Loader Awareness, Dynamic Block Discovery & Modern Bytecode
highlights: Minecraft 1.21.6+ runtime compatibility with Single-JAR invariant
GLFW key input sanitization (proper -1 unbound state)
Edge-triggered KeyDown filtering (removes continuous F3+A re-tick symptom)
Direct light texture shader hook (Lcam;F)F illuminating terrain and entities persistently
Survival flight with double-tap activation and no-fall landing impact damage suppression
Client dynamic block detection and tag inspection without hardcoded IDs
z-index compositing and emissive layer management preventing depth-mask conflicts
Unified JEI search syntax with regex, @namespace, and is:placeable filters

runtimeModes.name: Dromar Classic
runtimeModes.description: Embeds the DLB LaunchWrapper as a nested entry inside the distribution. The installer extracts it into the libraries tree under net/minecraftxray/dlb/launchwrapper/2.4.1/.

runtimeModes.name: MB Unified Standalone
runtimeModes.description: LaunchWrapper classes reside directly at the root of the JAR. Operates as a single standalone library entry without secondary JAR extraction.

runtimeModes.name: Host Mod-Loader Coexistence
runtimeModes.description: Host environment provides the classloader; MB detects the host and injects only the AO tweaker and transformers without duplicating classloaders.

runtimeModes.name: MB Standalone Fallback
runtimeModes.description: Lightweight fallback classloader that activates automatically or via MB_FORCE_FALLBACK if modern module boundaries disrupt legacy delegation.

controls.description: Toggles active ore detection profile with custom block visibility and transparency.
Inverts face culling to reveal hollow caves, ravines, and underground dungeons.
Bypasses gamma and darkness scale. In MB, hooks directly into (Lcam;F)F light texture shader.
Opens the Swing configuration dialog to toggle blocks, add custom IDs, and select profiles.
Enables creative-like flight in survival mode. MB adds double-tap hotkey and landing fall damage suppression.
Increases or decreases horizontal and vertical flight velocity.
MB Suite ergonomic hotkeys to switch profiles instantly without cycling through GUI.

assetsArchitecture.description: Estratificación de recursos multimedia y gráficos del ecosistema X-Ray

historicalArchiveAO.deliveryStrategy: Progressive Cooldown (2.5s) con sondeo RAW en background (im_) y preservación de copia local en ao/img/
historicalArchiveAO.scope: 9 capturas canónicas originales publicadas por AmbientOcclusion durante la era web del mod (2016-2021)

modularSuiteMaster.provenance: Repositorio Nativo y Portal GitHub Pages (https://misterbartra.github.io/net/minecraftxray/)
modularSuiteMaster.deliveryStrategy: Resolución jerárquica en escalera de sucesión. Los recursos de evolución creados en suites posteriores (como la GUI reactiva v75/v76 o controles GLFW -1 de MB) son activos vivos de repositorio sin dependencia ontológica de Web Archive
modularSuiteMaster.scope: Activos de interfaz y controles evolucionados para versiones modernas (Minecraft 1.21.6+)
